notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Update – Bug Fixes

Thanks for all your reports! In this update, we've fixed several annoying issues:
- Fixed a bug with machines – you can now properly insert and remove items
- Fixed an issue where the player couldn't control their character after taking damage or dying
- Fixed a bug that prevented picking up items

notes.title: BOBER CONSTRUCTIONS DEMO NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Hello, builders!
We’re excited to announce that the DEMO of Bober Constructions is now live. Step into the role of a beaver-builder and test your skills in constructing walls, repairing roads, and tackling various building challenges!

What’s in store for you?
10 levels packed with challenges for ambitious builders
Creative co-op gameplay (currently local)
A lighthearted, humorous vibe inspired by games like Overcooked

Play the DEMO

Click here to play the Steam DEMO

If you enjoy our game, please add it to your wishlist! Your support helps us continue to develop Bober Constructions.

Join the discussion
Share your impressions in the comments and let us know what you’d like to see in future updates. We appreciate all of your ideas and feedback!

Happy building!
